reviews.text: Very good bathing job, the dogs are very happy

I took my pet for a consultation on a Sunday for the first time, and there were hardly any staff members.

They told us it would take 30 to 40 minutes to be seen, but we arrived at 12:15 pm, and it was 2:30 pm, and we still hadn't been seen!
I think that if they have a high demand for patients, they should be better organized. In fact, a dog arrived in an emergency, and even he didn't receive the attention he deserved. They tried to resolve everything with an apology, and that's not right!
Those who were lucky enough to see a veterinarian or professional staff were, but those of us who were there that long—and there were quite a few of us—weren't satisfied with anything, neither the service nor the attention.
Thank you for the 5 stars!

Highly recommended! The service was 10/10, they treated Frida wonderfully and she looked gorgeous.
You can tell how much love and attention they give to the dogs. We will definitely be back. ✨ (The service was done by Isaac, 10/10)

I never leave reviews. But I've had two emergency situations, and in both cases, they couldn't help me.

The first time, my dog ​​cut his tongue on a piece of glass, and they told me he needed stitches, but there was only one vet, and he couldn't do it.

The second time, my dog ​​pooped blood. I got to the "hospital," and they told me there was only one doctor (again) and that I'd have to wait an hour or more.
Thank you for the 5-star review! We hope to see you again soon, Isaac.
What happened?????, the quality of service has plummeted! Seriously, you either need to get your act together or you need to get your act together. Give everyone a zero rating for today.
Their service is very warm and professional, they have highly professional veterinarians and comfortable, clean facilities.
I wanted to ask for information about a service, Mrs. Blanca Huerta attended to me via WhatsApp and if they treat dogs like their customer service, I'd rather pass.
Although there's sometimes a wait, I appreciate the care they provide to the animals. It's a plus that they have 24-hour emergency service.
Terrible on Sunday. They are incapable of handling an emergency. They had one patient and couldn't do anything else.

The medical staff is very young and enthusiastic.
They provide information and explanations with great clarity and patience.
Medical records are easily accessible through their internal system.
They listen and follow up with patients through their communication channels.

A very pleasant experience.
Excellent care from Dr. Alejandro and thanks to Eduardo for always being present during each visit I have; I always have a great experience with you.

Cristian and Magaly provided excellent service!!! 100% recommended 😊
Lalo and Dr. Andrés also provided very good service.
I think it's an excellent hospital and all the doctors are super professional. …

I took my dog ​​for a general checkup. Everyone was very friendly (the doctors, receptionists, the gentleman at the entrance...). They made me feel very confident and gave my dog ​​her annual vaccinations—everything went well. However, after they did a dental cleaning, I noticed they had left one tooth exactly as it was before (completely gray). I mentioned it, and they said I owed them another cleaning. But for almost 5,000 pesos, I think her teeth should have been perfect, and besides, I don't want my dog ​​to be under anesthesia again and again. So that was a bit disappointing.
I have taken my cat to be vaccinated 3 times and we have received very good care.

I arrived at 10 PM and there was NO service.

So why advertise 24 hours? It was an emergency. Avoid going.
Dr. Jessica and Eduardo provided excellent service; I really loved it and highly recommend them.
Thank you for these 5 stars!

Yesterday I had the sad experience of having to put my dog ​​to sleep. When I arrived at the Miguel Ángel de Quevedo branch, Dr. Alejandro attended to us, and I must say I had never been there before. He treated us with true humanity and professionalism. In my otherwise very sad experience, they made saying goodbye much easier.
Excellent service during my golden retriever's surgery.
Excellent service, they performed a great operation on my dog ​​and took excellent care of her, returning her in good condition. Thank you so much!

I've had to go to the clinic several times, and everyone has been very kind to me. Cristian Aguilera has been very supportive, both personally and over the phone. I'm very happy with the clinic and its staff.
At Animalitos Miguel Ángel, the care has been excellent. Dr. Magaly, Dr. Itzel, and Dr. Mariel have greatly helped my little ones improve their health.
I brought my pet in for an emergency, and the service was excellent. They explained everything very well, especially the young man named Eduardo.
Hi, 100% recommended. Thank you Eduardo for your attention, your recommendations, and for keeping an eye on my dog.

Special thanks to Eduardo at reception. He's always attentive, very kind, and provides excellent service. I always take my pets there; they offer comprehensive service and have the equipment and facilities to provide top-notch care.

They're excellent veterinarians; the one at the counter is incredibly friendly and attentive.
I'm very grateful to Animalitos.
Very good veterinarians with a lot of experience, I recommend them

I like the place, but honestly I'm disappointed that they keep changing doctors. We went a week and a half ago to see Dr. Magali, who gave my mom's dog the wrong prescription, and thanks to Dr. Alejandro our dog is better. Thanks also to Eduardo for always being such a smiling person who welcomes you in the best way.
Very good place
They used to be great, now you're better off looking for other options.

DO NOT GO THERE FOR EMERGENCIES.
They refused to treat my cat for an emergency, and he ended up dying. I don't know why they claim to be a 24-hour hospital with emergency services.
They are incredibly indifferent and awful.

If you need urgent care, this is not the place. They refused to attend to an emergency "because the vet wasn't there," at 6 a.m., at a 24-hour hospital. They refused to treat my pet and told me, "Go to Brussels because I have critically ill dogs." Despite our pleas and the promise of payment, they turned us away everywhere. Unfortunately, my pet passed away. If you love your pet, think twice before going there.
It used to be a great place, but lately the staff there have no idea what customer service is—I'm talking about the Miguel Angel de Quevedo branch! It's a shame! I definitely won't be back.
There used to be good service with the doctors who worked there, but since they changed all the doctors and the reception staff, the service has changed.

I really appreciate the staff's service, especially that of the receptionists Astrid and Eduardo, and the police officer is a lovely person. Regarding the change of doctors, I don't agree with it, and I think they had good doctors. It doesn't reflect well on the hospital.
It's an excellent place. They're always friendly, very accurate with diagnoses, and they really pamper the dogs that stay at their boarding facility. I highly recommend them! 👌🏻 …

The lack of education, empathy, professionalism, ethics, and basic human decency shown by "Dr." Magaly Leon is unbelievable. Here, you're a customer, not a patient, and her only interest is in charging you as much as possible. If this reflects how this chain operates (which it seems to), then I absolutely do not recommend her. She didn't treat my dog, didn't ask his name, didn't pet him, and showed absolutely no interest in his medical emergency. A terrible doctor and a terrible person.

I've been there a few times and my experience has always been good, especially when Eduardo helps me with questions or follow-ups with the doctors, since they've had staff changes, but my visits have always gone well.

Good morning. I am dismayed, saddened, and upset. I have seven pets that I bring here for everything, and their veterinarians are Dr. David Segundo and Dr. Camila Álvarez. Pet care isn't cheap, and you pay for the service and trustworthiness of your doctors. I don't agree with them taking away our most trusted and highly qualified veterinarians. They were always changing doctors, but they were always attentive and made sure their patients received the best care and service. I've paid a lot of money because my doctors gave me complete confidence. If they're not here, I'm not satisfied or at ease. I'm sorry, but I'm disappointed, and I've been informed that the two best doctors are no longer here. Unless one of them is still here, I'll look for alternatives. It's a real mistake. Their best doctors, who gave this clinic, Miguel Ángel de Quevedo, that extra something, are gone. I am available for any comments. Thank you.
Maritza Triay
Terrible service 😡 …
Thank you!! Come back soon!!

My dog ​​had an ultrasound, and they reported that everything was fine. He was sent home with treatment.

I returned two days later because I didn't see any improvement. I requested an emergency appointment, and we waited almost two hours.

I immediately took him to another hospital, and they pointed out findings from the ultrasound.

I'm not sure if they even did the first ultrasound, and if they did, they definitely didn't interpret it correctly.
Why are they playing with people's urgent needs? They advertise 24-hour service, but it's a lie. It's closed. What a lack of ethics!

WARNING 🚨

If you have the opportunity to visit this place, DON'T TAKE IT.

We went to this hospital after confirming they were open, we scheduled an appointment and everything, and upon arrival they simply told us that the veterinarian hadn't arrived and that they wouldn't have any staff all day. Only the security guard and receptionist were there, and they told us to do whatever we wanted. I can't imagine what would happen if one of the hospitalized animals had an emergency and there was no one to attend to them. They clearly have a serious lack of ethics, professionalism, and dedication, and considering the prices, they are only interested in money and NOT the well-being of the pets.

Don't risk your little ones 😢 there are better options!

Dr. Daniel Sotelo treated my baby Lolo in the emergency room in the early morning. He gave an accurate diagnosis and appropriate treatment. My baby is healthy and growing. The follow-up care is personalized. We have 100% confidence in the doctor and the hospital.

Animalitos Veterinary Hospital is a prime example of how mismanagement can completely ruin a place that should exist to care for animals. From the moment you walk in, you sense the chaos, the lack of professionalism, and a "make money, that's it" attitude.
The owners leave much to be desired. Their management is clearly mediocre, lacking ethics and dedication, where humane treatment and love for animals take a back seat. Everything seems to revolve around the business, not veterinary medicine.
The care is deficient, disorganized, and gives the impression that no one is truly in control of what's happening. It doesn't inspire confidence to leave your pet in a place where improvisation and administrative negligence seem to reign supreme.
A hospital like this shouldn't be operating as a hospital. If you value your pet, look for another option.

We really like this hospital. It's small, and it's true that at night there might only be one doctor on call for emergencies, which I've noticed bothers some people. But in my experience, having tried several places, most are like that, with only one or two on call. What I would say makes the difference is the care and the response, and at least in our case, it has always been good.
Case: A mixed-breed dog, almost 19 years old, with no definitive diagnosis, presents with pleural fluid accumulation periodically and the presence of small nodules in her lungs.

While the services are in a considerable price range (mid to high), at least in our experience it has been worth it. They have treated my Sandy with professionalism and great care. Daniel S. has attended to us promptly and kindly at night, and has always put us at ease in emergencies (he shows and explains everything). Unlike other places where she would leave depressed and anxious, and even with many side effects from anesthesia, with them, especially with their two main veterinarians, Daniel and David Segundo, she even lets us hold her and leaves calm, without any side effects from medication. Unfortunately, due to the risk involved in the procedure that would give us a definitive diagnosis, we didn't have it done. However, we are very grateful to them and to the receptionist (the receptionist is rather apathetic, unlike the receptionist). We had already been taking Sandy to two other places, and without a diagnosis, the only thing they could do was thoracentesis whenever fluid accumulated in her lungs. But it's a somewhat invasive procedure that requires anesthesia, which is already risky and uncomfortable. The other place's option was to euthanize her, which they told us tactlessly and with the intention of no longer treating her because they didn't know what was wrong with her. Here, on the other hand, they referred us to the cardiologist and the oncologist as soon as possible. She had several tests done, and they always gave us the results, even when she was hospitalized (it's worth adding that the nightly rate isn't expensive, and they don't ask for a huge deposit). They also made sure she had everything she needed, and they sent us a daily report on her progress (a great detail that speaks volumes about their care is that They even send you a photo of the day, noting how often she's had a bowel movement and whether she's eaten and drunk water. While thoracentesis isn't strictly a treatment procedure, it's what gives her a better quality of life. Here, they gave us options and were very empathetic and understanding. We know that if she's in pain and it becomes too much for Sandy, we'll have to make a decision. However, based on how they saw Sandy, euthanasia wasn't an option. For her age, she's incredibly active; she runs, jumps, and seems like nothing's wrong, even though fluid is starting to accumulate in her lungs. That's why they decided to continue with the treatment and the thoracentesis. I love that, unlike at the other hospital, here she doesn't leave after each thoracentesis anxious, depressed, with diarrhea, or sore from shaving. It's almost as if they didn't even perform the procedure because she leaves happy and eager to run around even more. And fortunately, the need for the procedure is becoming more and more sporadic; we went from needing it once a month to now having it three months without needing it. She's almost 19 years old, and while at the other hospital she would already be dead, here they have allowed us to keep her longer and with a good quality of life. Thanks to David Segundo and Daniel for taking such good care of her.

Terrible service at this veterinary clinic.

From the very beginning, the care was deficient and unprofessional. At no point did they show any genuine interest in my pet's health and well-being; on the contrary, the constant feeling was that their priority was getting paid, not providing proper care.

The staff didn't review the medical records, made unfounded comments, and proposed unnecessary procedures and charges, generating unjustified alarm and fear about my pet's health. Instead of explaining things clearly, they scare the client into accepting tests or treatments without a proper examination or a clear diagnosis.

The lack of empathy, poor communication, and absence of responsible medical judgment left me with complete distrust and the impression that there is no real commitment to animals, only financial gain.

I consider this experience unacceptable, especially when it involves the health of a living being. I would not recommend this place and hope that measures are taken to improve professional ethics, medical care, and the treatment of pets and their owners.

😡🤬I went there out of emergency, desperation, and because I was close to my pet, and it was the WORST MISTAKE. Awful, ZERO EMPATHY towards the animals. Pure business, they don't care about the lives of the animals or the pain of the humans. DO NOT TAKE YOUR PETS THERE. I will never set foot there again! Terrible service. They only care about making money. They don't deliver results, they just make up the costs. Unrealistic quotes, taking advantage of the vulnerability of the situation. You give everything for your pets, no matter how much it costs, just to save them, but they ABUSE and LIE. The abuse is disgusting. I signed the voluntary discharge form, and what they told me was NOTHING like what my trusted VET diagnosed. (Unfortunately, I went there because my VET wasn't in town at the time). I DO NOT RECOMMEND IT 🤬😡

My precious daughter passed away on December 24th at 10 pm. They attended to me very quickly, but it was too late. They didn't charge me anything and even let me change the funeral home without any problem. I am very grateful for their attention and will be eternally thankful.

Today, Wednesday, December 3, 2025, I had an emergency with my dog. It's a lie that they're open 24 hours. I went at 10 PM, rang the doorbell several times with my wife and my dog. I called the number listed and no one answered. It's a lie that they have 24-hour service; they just waste time in a medical emergency. I will never return nor recommend them. I went to another clinic that is open 24 hours and they treated my pet.

Terrible service from "veterinarian" Jose Daniel Flores Manzano, ID number 14503913. His attitude was awful, as was the receptionist's. If you have the chance to go to this branch, DO NOT LET HIM TREAT YOUR PETS!!!!! WE PAY FOR A SERVICE, HE DOESN'T GIVE IT TO US FOR FREE!!!!
The staff's attention was good, however I think the owners have excessively raised the costs per haircut, more than $600 for a 7-kilo dog, I think it's an abuse.
Excellent service
Excellent service. The doctors are very professional and attentive. They explain any questions you may have.
I brought my Pomeranian puppies in for a general check-up and they were treated very well and everything was explained to me in detail. I'm very satisfied 😁 …

We took our dog to the emergency vet, however, despite seeing her condition, it took them approximately 20 minutes to give us an estimate of what they were going to do to her. Approximately 40 minutes after we arrived, they finally took her into emergency surgery, and she died.

-1 ⭐️
Their way of working makes me question their professionalism, whether they have the proper training or the necessary specialization to handle complex or even relatively simple cases.
Terrible place, I'd give it 0 stars if I could.

If I could give it zero stars, I would. Unfortunately, that's not possible.
My cat Coco, an 8-year-old male, was admitted to the clinic with difficulty walking on his hind legs and lower back pain. An X-ray was performed, after which the veterinarian diagnosed cauda equina syndrome and spondylosis, recommending hospitalization for pain management and intravenous hydration.
During the visit on November 6th at 3:50 p.m., we noticed a slight improvement, but his paw was completely covered in blood, as was the IV line. Furthermore, we observed that he wasn't urinating and had no access to a litter box, as he was only wearing a diaper. We had brought a bag of litter since 11:00 a.m., which was never used, remaining closed until the time of the visit. The staff constantly contradicted each other: one veterinarian claimed the litter had already been put in, while another admitted it hadn't. The disorganization was evident.

The place where they kept him smelled bad, and coconut too, because he kept urinating in his diaper.

But when it came to collecting payment, they were incredibly efficient: the moment you arrived, the first thing they did was remind you about the payment.
However, the medical care was deficient. I requested the X-rays taken on the 5th, and they still hadn't given them to me by the 6th, nor the lab results (CBC, CBC). They gave me evasive answers time and time again. They were finally given to me after his hospitalization ended.
When I reviewed the bill, I noticed that no pain medication was listed, even though that was the main reason for his hospitalization. I asked about it, and the doctors said he was being given it, but they were hesitant. In the end, they redone the note and added it, but it leaves a lot to be desired, and we don't know if they actually administered it.

A urinalysis was also ordered due to the presence of hematuria (blood in the urine), but the results “miraculously” showed no red blood cells. Upon consulting these results with two external veterinarians, both concluded that Coco did indeed have a urinary tract infection, which was not treated, and yet he was discharged without any medication.

During his stay, he did not have a regular veterinarian; a different person attended to him each time. No one seemed to know the patient's true condition or provide follow-up care. Ultimately, his diagnosis proved incorrect, confirmed by his primary care physician, who stated that the findings did not correspond with the symptoms or the imaging.

It is unacceptable that a veterinary clinic operates with such incompetent and disorganized staff, incapable of conducting a proper medical history, a complete physical examination, or a correct interpretation of imaging and laboratory results. Furthermore, they order tests and refer patients to specialists without knowing why, demonstrating a complete lack of professional ethics and respect for the animals and their owners.

The service I received was, in short, negligent, uninformed, and inhumane.

Therefore, I will take the appropriate steps to follow up on this case. I do not recommend this place under any circumstances.

Look for other grooming options. Their staff has little knowledge about cutting, brushing, and bathing poodle-type dogs. I took my dog ​​for a bath and grooming, and they did a terrible job. I complained, and they offered me another free service, but the same thing happened. The last time I took him for a bath, they didn't dry him properly and left knots, resulting in a skin infection. Today, professionals who actually know what they're doing are shaving him to save him from serious skin problems. So, the typical scenario is this: a company that invests a lot in its location but probably pays its staff next to nothing, resulting in inexperienced employees who don't know how to do their jobs. And the worst part is, if you want to resolve something, they tell you to call corporate. I admit it was my mistake to think they were ethical and committed to their work.

This vet clinic is awful. I went there because it's only one block from my house.
I don't know what they did to my cat (she was 3 months old), but she's been very withdrawn ever since. I don't know what "pseudo-technique" they used, but the poor thing was terrified.
Why do they have so many clinics? They take the animals to another place and you can't go with them.
And to top it all off, they charge you for everything, even the syringes... My God!!! They not only charge for the consultation, but also for everything they use to "cure" your pet. Soon they'll be charging you for the air you breathe while you wait to be seen. They don't even have medicine.
Fortunately, I'm now going to my regular vet, who is also 24-hour, but his office is all the way in San Jerónimo. Unfortunately, it was an emergency, and since this so-called vet clinic was an emergency clinic, I trusted them. Don't go there; they'll take advantage of any situation to get your pet to need another service so they can charge more. Note: I'd give it zero stars, but you have to rate it. And from what I'm seeing, they only reply to positive comments. Very bad, they only accept compliments.

👎👎👎👎👎

A few months ago, I would have given it five stars. My dog ​​had surgery here twice and had been coming for four years, until today when, for the second time, I received poor treatment from the staff at the MAQ grooming salon.

For the second time, the grooming staff were rude and didn't do their job properly or on time. The first time, they didn't return my dog ​​after a bath on time, and despite their negligence, they blamed me for bringing a "dirty" dog in for a bath. This second time, upon realizing who I was, they fabricated a story, putting words in my mouth that I never said.

If the company wants to keep these employees, that's their decision, just as it's my decision not to go back.
It's a shame to go from having warm and friendly service to having a rude individual and a mocking young woman who does nothing but look at her cell phone instead of working and putting herself in this situation with customers.
Today it was me, but I'm sure more customers will encounter these individuals in the coming weeks.

Yesterday I went to the emergency vet at night because my cat was injured, and although the sign said it was open 24 hours, and the door was open, there was NO ONE there. I called and they told me they weren't providing service. Even though they clearly had their "open 24 hours" sign, which I find ironic since it was on but they weren't actually providing service. And the worst part was that I had an emergency with a sick and defenseless pet and he didn't receive the care he deserved. Anyway, I had to go to another vet and they DID treat him, and even with better prices and better service. They just lost a customer.

Excellent care, very professional. My dog ​​had surgery in the orthopedic department and I was extremely satisfied with the result, the care, and the follow-up. I highly recommend both the MAQ hospital and the orthopedic surgeons.
Terrible telephone service, I called several times for an emergency and no one answered me, they left me on hold for several minutes until the call ended.

Today I took my dog ​​Yoi to the groomer. Susana took care of her and was incredibly kind and careful. Yoi is difficult to groom when trimming her nails and fur, but Susana made her look beautiful. Thank you for your care and the love you show. I hope she'll groom her again next time; it's so important to have such wonderful people like her at the salon. 💗
Excellent service from Dr. Monica

Doctors Juan Pablo and David provided excellent care, showing great professionalism and care for my pet. Their commitment and empathy were evident, which I greatly appreciate.

Likewise, the reception staff was always friendly, including the security guard.

On the other hand, Doctor Mónica Iniesta performed very poorly: she stated that my pet was terminally ill without showing empathy or offering any alternatives, which I found very unprofessional at such a delicate time. Ultimately, my pet passed away, and the pain is immense. Doctor Mónica lacked sensitivity and was only interested in ordering more tests that, frankly, weren't necessary.

For this reason, I'm giving 4 stars instead of 5, hoping that they will supervise their work, because the rest of the team truly makes a great effort and deserves recognition. This doesn't mean, however, that they should always be pushing for unnecessary surgeries or tests.
Thank you for everything ❤️‍🩹❤️‍🩹❤️‍🩹 …

Terrible service. I had an appointment to bathe my dog, and when I arrived at the scheduled time, they told me they couldn't see her because there was another appointment at that time and that it was a communication error. This isn't the first time I've tried to schedule an appointment, and there are always communication problems. I will never return.

Terrible service, you call to make an appointment and they tell you there aren't any and you have to wait. I waited almost two hours for a vaccine and all the cubicles were empty. I wanted to make an appointment for a bath and haircut and they told me there were no appointments and that they didn't have enough staff to attend to the patients.
